webhook.title: Data Intake & Webhook
webhook.help: Security and rate of the endpoint that receives positions from GPS.id.

detection.title: Movement Detection
detection.help: Offline threshold and geofence for arrive/depart detection.

deviation.title: Route Deviation Alerts
deviation.help: Thresholds & severity for alerts when a vehicle deviates from its planned route/schedule.

maps.title: Map API Keys
maps.help: Google Maps keys for rendering maps and snap-to-road corridors.

weighbridge.title: Weighbridge
weighbridge.help: Rate limit for TPA weighbridge API requests.

baseUrl.label: GPS.id API URL
baseUrl.help: GPS.id API endpoint. Default: https://portal.gps.id/backend/seen/public — change only if the vendor provides a different one.

username.label: GPS.id Username
username.help: GPS.id API account username, from the GPS.id dashboard or vendor.

password.label: GPS.id Password
password.help: GPS.id API account password (from the vendor). Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep unchanged.

vehicleSync.label: Auto vehicle sync
vehicleSync.help: When on, the GPS.id vehicle roster is synced on a schedule (matching GPS devices to vehicles by plate).

vehicleSyncIntervalMin.label: Sync interval (minutes)
vehicleSyncIntervalMin.help: How often the roster auto-syncs, in minutes. E.g. 1440 = once a day.

positionPull.label: Auto position pull
positionPull.help: When on, each active device's position history is pulled from GPS.id periodically (complements the push webhook).

pullIntervalMin.label: Pull interval (minutes)
pullIntervalMin.help: How often positions are auto-pulled, in minutes. E.g. 1440 = once a day.

webhookToken.label: GPS.id webhook token
webhookToken.help: Secret token in the webhook URL (POST /integrations/gps/webhook/:token). Generate a random string ≥16 chars and register the URL with GPS.id. Stored encrypted.

allowedIps.label: Allowed webhook IPs (comma-separated)
allowedIps.help: Comma-separated allowlist of webhook source IPs (e.g. GPS.id egress IPs). Leave empty to allow any IP and rely on the token.

ingestRateLimitPerMin.label: Webhook rate limit (per minute)
ingestRateLimitPerMin.help: Max webhook posts per minute per IP (flood protection). Default 600.

deviceOfflineMinutes.label: Device offline after (minutes)
deviceOfflineMinutes.help: A device sending no position for this many minutes is marked offline on the map. Default 10.

geofenceDefaultRadiusM.label: Default geofence radius (m)
geofenceDefaultRadiusM.help: Geofence radius (meters) for arrive/depart detection, used when a site has no radius of its own. Default 100.

serverKey.label: Maps key (server)
serverKey.help: Server-side Google Maps key for snap-to-road corridors. Create in Google Cloud Console → enable Directions API, restrict by server IP. Stored encrypted.

browserKey.label: Maps key (browser)
browserKey.help: Google Maps key for rendering maps in the browser. Create in Google Cloud Console → enable Maps JavaScript API, restrict by HTTP referrer (app domain). Stored encrypted.

rateLimitPerMin.label: Weighbridge rate limit (per minute)
rateLimitPerMin.help: Max TPA weighbridge API requests per minute. Default 500.

deviation.hintThresholdM: Distance limit before it counts as a deviation, in meters — e.g. 150 means off-corridor beyond 150 m from the path.
deviation.hintThresholdS: Limit before the condition is recorded as a deviation, in seconds.
deviation.hintHysteresis: How long the condition must persist before the alarm fires — damps brief GPS spikes to avoid false alarms. E.g. 30 = must deviate for 30 s first.
deviation.hintSeverity: Alarm severity when this rule triggers: Info (note), Warning, or Critical (most urgent).

off_corridor.label: Off corridor
off_corridor.hint: Distance from the corridor before it counts as a deviation

off_sequence.label: Wrong stop order
off_sequence.hint: Visiting sites out of the planned order

dwell_too_long.label: Idle too long
dwell_too_long.hint: Stationary outside a site geofence beyond the limit

late_to_schedule.label: Late vs schedule
late_to_schedule.hint: Arriving later than the target time
